hadi-march/ui#PercentInput.name: PercentInput
hadi-march/ui#PercentInput.doc: Percent: shows 12.5 % for a stored 0.125 (`fraction={false}` stores 12.5).

props.name: fraction
props.doc: `false` stores 12.5 for 12.5 % (default: 0.125).

props.name: step
props.doc: ArrowUp / ArrowDown step (display units).

props.name: scale
props.doc: Display = value × scale.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: autofocus
props.doc: Focus this field when it appears.

hadi-march/ui#PhoneInput.name: PhoneInput
hadi-march/ui#PhoneInput.doc: Phone number: keeps "+" and digits only. Props: country (e.g. "+44", shown as a prefix). Value: "+447700900123".

props.name: country
props.doc: Country calling code ("+44"), shown as a prefix and prepended to national numbers.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: autofocus
props.doc: Focus this field when it appears.

hadi-march/ui#PhoneInput.tr: Telefon numarası: yalnızca "+" ve rakamları tutar. Prop'lar: country (örn. "+44", önek olarak gösterilir). Değer: "+447700900123".

hadi-march/ui#pickerKind.name: pickerKind
hadi-march/ui#pickerKind.signature: function pickerKind(options: readonly Option[], kind: PickerKind | "auto" = "auto"): PickerKind

hadi-march/ui#pickMain.name: pickMain
hadi-march/ui#pickMain.doc: The main provider that `<Widget>` would draw for this input (exported for tests and tools).
hadi-march/ui#pickMain.signature:
function pickMain

(sources: readonly WidgetPoint

[], input: P): WidgetProvider

| undefined
hadi-march/ui#pickMain.tr: `<Widget>`'ın bu girdi için çizeceği ana sağlayıcı (test ve araçlar için dışa aktarılır).

hadi-march/ui#Picture.name: Picture
hadi-march/ui#Picture.doc: `<Picture source={project.cover} />`, `<Picture src="/hero.jpg" alt="…" width={1200} height={800} loading="eager" fit="cover" />`

props.name: source
props.doc: A picture object or a ready node (a node is returned as it is).

props.name: alt
props.doc: Alternative text ("" marks a decorative image).

props.name: loading
props.doc: "lazy" (default) or "eager": loads at once with high priority (the first screen).

props.name: fit
props.doc: How the image fills its box when it is sized by the parent: "cover", "contain". Default: its natural size, never wider than the box.

props.name: fallback
props.doc: Shown instead of the image when it fails to load: text or a node.

hadi-march/ui#Picture.tr: Resim nesnesini (`{ src, alt, width, height, srcset, sizes }`) tembel yüklenen bir `` olarak çizer, hazır düğümü olduğu gibi döndürür: ``

hadi-march/ui#place.name: place
hadi-march/ui#place.doc: Compute a fixed position for `panel` next to `anchor`.
hadi-march/ui#place.signature: function place(anchor: Element, panel: Element | null | undefined, placement: Placement = "bottom-start", gap: number = 6): PlacedStyle
hadi-march/ui#place.tr: `panel` için `anchor` yanında sabit bir konum hesaplar.

hadi-march/ui#pointer.name: pointer
hadi-march/ui#pointer.doc: "/a/0/b~1c" (RFC 6901 JSON pointer) for a path; "" is the root.
hadi-march/ui#pointer.tr: Bir yol için "/a/0/b~1c" (RFC 6901 JSON işaretçisi); "" kök demektir.

hadi-march/ui#Popover.name: Popover

props.name: trigger
props.doc: What opens it: a node (a Button, an IconButton — it gets the click and the ARIA), text (becomes a Button), or `(api) => node` when you wire it yourself.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: Place the panel by this element instead of the trigger (a field, a virtual caret rectangle).

props.name: open
props.doc: Controlled open state: a signal (two-way), a value / accessor, or `bind:open`. Without it the popover keeps its own.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.doc: Own state: open at first.

props.name: title
props.doc: A small header in the panel (PanelHeader).

props.name: closable
props.doc: A close button in the header (default: with a title).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the panel when it has no title.

props.name: role
props.doc: Role of the panel (default "dialog"); "menu" / "listbox" when the content is one; null for none.

props.name: motion
props.doc: Entrance: "scale" (default), "fade", "rise", or "none".

props.name: width
props.doc: Width of the panel: "auto" (its content, default), "sm", "md", "lg".

props.name: flush
props.doc: No padding around the content (a list that fills the panel).

props.name: footer
props.doc: Under the content: buttons.

props.name: closeOnOutside
props.doc: A press outside closes (default true).

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.doc: Escape closes (default true).

props.name: autoFocus
props.doc: On open, focus the first control in the panel (default true); false leaves focus where it is (a field that keeps typing).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme colour inside the panel.

props.name: class
props.doc: Class of the wrapper around the trigger.

props.name: panelClass
props.doc: Class of the floating panel.

props.name: children
props.type: unknown | ((close: (refocus?: boolean) => void, api: PopoverApi) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: The panel content, or `(close, api) => content`.

hadi-march/ui#Popover.tr: Tetikleyici ve yanında yüzen panel: dışarı tıklama ya da Esc ile kapanır, odak içeri girip tetikleyiciye döner; açıklık kendi durumu ya da `open` ile denetlenir. `<Popover trigger={<Button>Süzgeçler</Button>} title="Süzgeçler">…</Popover>`.

hadi-march/ui#PostCard.name: PostCard
hadi-march/ui#PostCard.doc: `<PostCard post={p} onLike={(on) => like(p, on)} onComment={openComments} onOpenMedia={(i, el) => lightbox(p.media, i, el)} />`

props.name: onLike
props.doc: Called with the next like state; update the post (optimistic).

props.name: onOpenMedia
props.type: ((index: number, el: HTMLElement, post: Post) => void) | undefined

props.name: menu
props.doc: ⋯ menu items (args: [post]).

props.name: variant
props.doc: card: framed · flat: no frame (a feed with dividers). Default card.

props.name: clamp
props.doc: Lines before "more". Default 3; 0 never folds.

props.name: doubleTapLike
props.doc: Double tap on the photos likes. Default true.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Own texts (names of the article and the buttons, "more", "View all N comments").

props.name: avatar
props.doc: The author's avatar. Default true.

props.name: time
props.doc: The time in the header: true (default, relative), false, or `(time) => content`.

props.name: verifiedIcon
props.doc: Own icons (an icon of hadi-march/icons, text or a node); `false` hides the verified mark, the place pin or the large heart.

props.name: bigHeart
props.doc: The large heart of a double tap: default, `false` (the post is liked without it) or your own node.

props.name: likeColor
props.doc: Heart color while liked (default: brand-pink).

props.name: viewAll
props.doc: The "View all N comments" line. Default true.

hadi-march/ui#PostCard.tr: `<PostCard post={p} onLike={(on) => like(p, on)} onComment={openComments} onOpenMedia={(i, el) => lightbox(p.media, i, el)} />` — gönderi kartı.

hadi-march/ui#PostSkeleton.name: PostSkeleton
hadi-march/ui#PostSkeleton.doc: A post-shaped placeholder: avatar, two lines, a photo, an action row.
hadi-march/ui#PostSkeleton.signature: function PostSkeleton(props: { media?: boolean; variant?: "card" | "flat" | undefined }): Element
hadi-march/ui#PostSkeleton.tr: Gönderi biçimli yer tutucu: avatar, iki satır, bir fotoğraf, bir eylem satırı.

hadi-march/ui#preloadPalette.name: preloadPalette
hadi-march/ui#preloadPalette.doc: Fetch the palette view now (it is otherwise loaded on first open).
hadi-march/ui#preloadPalette.tr: Palet görünümünü şimdi getirir (aksi halde ilk açılışta yüklenir).

hadi-march/ui#pressedAttr.name: pressedAttr
hadi-march/ui#pressedAttr.doc: `aria-pressed` value of a `pressed` prop (shared with IconButton): null when the prop is not set, so a plain button carries no state.
hadi-march/ui#pressedAttr.signature: const pressedAttr: (p: MaybeFn<boolean | null | undefined>) => "true" | "false" | null
hadi-march/ui#pressedAttr.tr: Bir `pressed` prop'unun `aria-pressed` değeri (Button ile IconButton ortak kullanır); prop verilmediyse null, yani düz düğme durum taşımaz.

hadi-march/ui#previewFrame.name: previewFrame
hadi-march/ui#previewFrame.doc: A same-origin page in a frame (h() never creates <iframe>: only pages of this site, never another origin).
hadi-march/ui#previewFrame.signature: function previewFrame(src: MaybeFn<string | undefined>, title: MaybeFn<string>, cls: string): HTMLIFrameElement
hadi-march/ui#previewFrame.tr: Yalnız bu sitenin bir sayfasını gösteren çerçeve (başka köken boş kalır); önizlemeler için.

hadi-march/ui#ProfileHeader.name: ProfileHeader
hadi-march/ui#ProfileHeader.doc: `<ProfileHeader user={u} follow={$f} onFollow={(s) => $f = s} onMessage={openChat} onStat={openList} />`

props.name: self
props.doc: Your own profile: no follow / message, an Edit button instead (onEdit).

props.name: cover
props.doc: Cover height: sm 120 · md 168 · lg 216 px. Default md.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Own texts (section name, Edit profile, Message, the stat names …).

props.name: stats
props.doc: The stats row: true (default: all three), false, or the ones to show in order (`["followers", "following"]`).

props.name: verifiedIcon
props.doc: Own icons (an icon of hadi-march/icons, text or a node); `false` hides the verified mark or the Message icon.

props.name: messageColor
props.doc: Color of the Message button (default: a neutral surface).

hadi-march/ui#ProfileHeader.tr: `<ProfileHeader user={u} follow={$f} onFollow={(s) => $f = s} onMessage={openChat} onStat={openList} />` — profil üst bölümü.

hadi-march/ui#Progress.name: Progress
hadi-march/ui#Progress.doc: `<Progress value={$p} label="Uploading" showValue />`, `<Progress />` (indeterminate), `<Progress variant="line" fillRef={(el) => scrollIndicator(el)} />`, `<Progress segments={5} value={$i} duration={6000} onDone={next} />`.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token (see ColorToken): "brand-blue", "success", "cat-3"… Default: the theme's primary.

props.name: colors
props.doc: Several colors: "brand" (the four HADİ colors, the HADİ theme's default), a list of color tokens, or "single" (one color even in a multicolor theme).

props.name: paint
props.doc: How several colors are laid out: "gradient" (default), "segments" (equal parts) or "cycle" (colors flow).

props.name: value
props.doc: 0..max; omit (or null) for an indeterminate bar.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name when there is no visible `label` (default "Progress", translated).

props.name: showValue
props.doc: Show the percentage next to the label; a function writes its own text: `(percent, value) => "3 of 8 files"`.

props.name: size
props.doc: Track thickness: "sm" | "md" | "lg", or a number of pixels.

props.name: variant
props.doc: "bar" (default) or "line": a thin line whose fill is scaled along the track (reading bars, deck progress, rails).

props.name: orientation
props.doc: "horizontal" (default) or "vertical": the track stands and fills from the top.

props.name: fillRef
props.doc: Receives the fill element, for a driver that writes its transform itself (`scrollIndicator(fill, source)`, an animation). The bar is then never indeterminate; `value`, when given, only feeds the ARIA value.

props.name: smooth
props.doc: Value changes glide (default true); false follows the value at once (a value driven every frame).

props.name: track
props.doc: The track behind the fill (default true); false leaves only the fill.

props.name: inverse
props.doc: Over media: a white fill on a translucent track (`color` still paints the fill).

props.name: decorative
props.doc: Hidden from assistive technology (another element already says the progress).

props.name: segments
props.doc: Equal parts instead of one track. `value` counts the full parts (`max` defaults to the number of parts): 2 of 5 fills the first two; 2.5 also half of the third.

props.name: duration
props.doc: Segments: the part at `value` (0-based) fills over this many ms on the motion engine, then `onDone` fires.

props.name: paused
props.doc: Holds the timed fill.

props.name: run
props.doc: Restarts the timed fill when it changes (the id of what the part stands for).

props.name: onDone
props.doc: The timed fill of the current part is complete.

props.name: valueText
props.doc: Text read instead of the number (`aria-valuetext`): `(value, max) => "Story 2 of 5"`.

hadi-march/ui#prompt.name: prompt
hadi-march/ui#prompt.doc: Ask for a text value. `validate(v)` returns an error message or null. Resolves the string, or null when cancelled.
hadi-march/ui#prompt.tr: Metin değeri ister. `validate(v)` hata iletisi ya da null döndürür. Dizeyi, iptal edilirse null ile çözülür.

hadi-march/ui#PROP_RANGE.name: PROP_RANGE
hadi-march/ui#PROP_RANGE.doc: Editable range of each animated property (min, max, step).
hadi-march/ui#PROP_RANGE.tr: Her animasyonlu özelliğin düzenlenebilir aralığı (min, max, step).

hadi-march/ui#PROP_UNIT.name: PROP_UNIT
hadi-march/ui#PROP_UNIT.doc: Unit shown after each animated property value.
hadi-march/ui#PROP_UNIT.tr: Her animasyonlu özellik değerinin ardından gösterilen birim.

hadi-march/ui#PropertyGrid.name: PropertyGrid
hadi-march/ui#PropertyGrid.doc: `<PropertyGrid properties={[{ key: "width", label: "Width", type: "number", group: "Layout", unit: "px" }]} bind:value={$props} onSave={save} />`

props.name: value
props.doc: The edited object: a signal, a live value with onChange / setValue, or `bind:value`.

props.name: saved
props.doc: Saved values to compare with (default: the value at start, then whatever onSave saved).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name and the DirtyState / undo label ("Button properties").

props.name: history
props.doc: Undo history (default: the app's undoStack()); false: none.

props.name: dirty
props.doc: Unsaved-changes registry (default: the app's dirtyState()); false: none.

props.name: id
props.doc: DirtyState id (default: generated).

props.name: groups
props.doc: Group order (others follow in the order they appear).

props.name: search
props.doc: Show the search field (default true).

props.name: layout
props.doc: "auto" (default): label beside the editor, stacked when narrow; "stacked": always above.

props.name: historyButtons
props.doc: The Undo / Redo buttons in the header (default true; the history itself is `history`).

props.name: resetButtons
props.doc: The "reset to saved" button of each row (default true).

props.name: changeMarks
props.doc: The dot beside a changed row's name and the changed count of a group (default true).

props.name: footer
props.doc: The footer with the change count, Revert and Save (default true).

props.name: labels
props.type: { search?: string; general?: string; empty?: string; noMatch?: (query: string) => string; changed?: string; changedCount?: (n: number) => string; unsaved?: (n: number) => string; noChanges?: string; revert?: unknown; save?: unknown; undo?: string; redo?: string; reset?: (label: string) => string; resetTitle?: string; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; defaults are the translated ones.

hadi-march/ui#PropertyGrid.tr: `<PropertyGrid properties={[{ key: "width", label: "Width", type: "number", group: "Layout", unit: "px" }]} bind:value={$props} onSave={save} />` — özellik ızgarası.

hadi-march/ui#PullToRefresh.name: PullToRefresh
hadi-march/ui#PullToRefresh.doc: `<PullToRefresh onRefresh={() => load()}>…long list…</PullToRefresh>` — the element itself is the scroll area.

props.name: onRefresh
props.doc: Runs when released past the threshold; the indicator spins until the returned promise settles.

props.name: threshold
props.doc: Pull distance (px) that triggers a refresh. Default 72.

props.name: onPhase
props.doc: Called on every phase change (idle → pull → ready → refreshing → idle).

props.name: labels
props.type: { pull?: string; release?: string; refreshing?: string; refresh?: string } | undefined
props.doc: The texts: the three announced states and the keyboard button. Defaults are translated.

props.name: indicator
props.doc: The round indicator: true (default), false, or `(phase) => content` drawn inside it (re-run on every phase).

props.name: icon
props.doc: Glyph or node that turns inside the indicator (default: the refresh glyph).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color of the indicator when ready and while refreshing (default: primary).

props.name: settle
props.doc: Settle (spring back) duration in ms; false or 0 snaps. Default 260.

props.name: refreshButton
props.doc: The keyboard "Refresh" button that appears on focus (default true).

hadi-march/ui#PullToRefresh.tr: `<PullToRefresh onRefresh={() => load()}>…long list…</PullToRefresh>` — kaydırma alanı öğenin kendisidir.

hadi-march/ui#QUICK_REACTIONS.name: QUICK_REACTIONS
hadi-march/ui#QUICK_REACTIONS.doc: Default quick-reaction row: the six emoji shown under a message.
hadi-march/ui#QUICK_REACTIONS.tr: Varsayılan hızlı tepki satırı: bir iletinin altında gösterilen altı emoji.

hadi-march/ui#quietMedia.name: quietMedia
hadi-march/ui#quietMedia.doc: True when heavy media should not run: save-data, 2G, or reduced motion.
hadi-march/ui#quietMedia.tr: Ağır medya çalıştırılmamalıysa true: veri tasarrufu, 2G ya da azaltılmış hareket.

hadi-march/ui#RadioGroup.name: RadioGroup
hadi-march/ui#RadioGroup.doc: Radio buttons; value is the chosen option value. Props: options, inline, variant ("segmented" too), colors…

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: colors
props.doc: "brand" (orange, blue, green, purple in turn) or a list of color tokens, one per option in turn.

props.name: variant
props.doc: Look of the control (default "classic").

props.name: shape
props.doc: Box corners (checkboxes; radios are round). Default "rounded".

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon (hadi-march/icons) shown instead of the drawn tick.

props.name: animate
props.doc: false: no animation.

hadi-march/ui#RadioGroup.tr: Radyo düğmeleri; değer seçilen seçenek değeridir. Prop'lar: options, inline, variant ("segmented" de), colors ve diğerleri.

hadi-march/ui#rank.name: rank
hadi-march/ui#rank.doc: Rank items. `get(item)` → { title, keywords }. Returns matching items, best first (stable for ties).
hadi-march/ui#rank.signature:
function rank<T extends RankFields>(query: string, items: readonly T[]): Ranked<T>[]
function rank<T>(query: string, items: readonly T[], get: (x: T) => RankFields): Ranked<T>[]
hadi-march/ui#rank.tr: Öğeleri sıralar. `get(item)` → { title, keywords }. Eşleşen öğeleri en iyiden başlayarak döndürür (eşitlikte kararlı).

hadi-march/ui#Rating.name: Rating
hadi-march/ui#Rating.doc: Star rating (radio group; ← → change): `<Rating bind:value={$stars} />`, `<Rating value={4.5} readonly />`

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token (see ColorToken): "brand-blue", "success", "cat-3"… Default: the theme's primary.

props.name: icon
props.doc: The empty mark instead of the star outline: an icon of hadi-march/icons, or `(n) => node` for your own drawing.

props.name: iconOn
props.doc: The filled mark instead of the filled star (same forms as `icon`).

props.name: starLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of a mark: `(n, max) => text` (default "3 of 5").

props.name: animate
props.doc: `false`: no hover growth and no fade between empty and filled.

hadi-march/ui#Rating.tr: Yıldız derecelendirme (radyo grubu; ← → değiştirir): `<Rating bind:value={$stars} />`, `<Rating value={4.5} readonly />`

hadi-march/ui#ReactionPicker.name: ReactionPicker

props.name: selected
props.doc: The current reaction (pressed).

props.name: layout
props.doc: row: a pill (reactions) · grid: a panel (emoji keyboard). Default row.

props.name: onMore
props.doc: A "+" at the end of a row (more emoji).

props.name: pop
props.doc: Pop-in animation when it appears. Default true.

props.name: emojiLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of an emoji button: `(emoji) => "Heart"`. Default: the emoji itself.

props.name: moreLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the "+" button. Default "More emoji".

props.name: moreIcon
props.doc: Your own content for the "+" button.

props.name: color
props.doc: Color of the picked emoji's circle and the focus ring. Default brand-blue.

hadi-march/ui#ReactionPicker.tr: `<ReactionPicker selected={msg.myReaction} onPick={(e) => react(msg, e)} />` — tepki seçici.

hadi-march/ui#readingProgressFeature.name: readingProgressFeature
hadi-march/ui#readingProgressFeature.doc: A thin bar at the top that fills as the page is read (keeps working with reduced motion: it is information).
hadi-march/ui#readingProgressFeature.valueType: (opts?: { color?: string; height?: number; label?: string; } | undefined) => LayoutFeature
hadi-march/ui#readingProgressFeature.tr: Layout özelliği: sayfanın üstünde okuma ilerleme çubuğu.

hadi-march/ui#RecordListEditor.name: RecordListEditor
hadi-march/ui#RecordListEditor.doc: Edit a list of records with a schema: add, remove, reorder, validate each row.

props.name: fields
props.doc: Sub-schema: a spec object or a schema.

props.name: blank
props.doc: New-row values (or a function returning them).

props.name: removable
props.doc: Default true.

props.name: sortable
props.doc: Default true.

props.name: cols
props.doc: Fields per line (default: number of fields, max 6).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#RecordListEditor.tr: Şemalı kayıt listesini düzenler: ekle, sil, yeniden sırala, her satırı doğrula.

hadi-march/ui#registerCommands.name: registerCommands
hadi-march/ui#registerCommands.doc: Register palette commands: [{ id, title, run, href, group, keywords, icon, shortcut, hidden, can }] or action() objects. `list` may be an accessor. Removed with the current owner, or call the returned function.
hadi-march/ui#registerCommands.signature: const registerCommands: (list: MaybeFn<readonly Command[] | null | undefined>) => (() => void)
hadi-march/ui#registerCommands.tr: Palet komutlarını kaydeder: [{ id, title, run, href, group, keywords, icon, shortcut, hidden, can }] ya da action() nesneleri. `list` bir erişimci olabilir. Mevcut sahip ile kaldırılır ya da dönen işlevi çağırın.

hadi-march/ui#registerInput.name: registerInput
hadi-march/ui#registerInput.doc: Register (or replace) the input used for a field type or `control` name.
hadi-march/ui#registerInput.signature: function registerInput(type: string, Component: InputComponent | null): void
hadi-march/ui#registerInput.tr: Bir alan türü ya da `control` adı için kullanılan girdiyi kaydeder (veya değiştirir).

hadi-march/ui#registerPages.name: registerPages
hadi-march/ui#registerPages.doc: Make pages ({ id, title, href, group, keywords, icon }) searchable. `list` may be an accessor. Returns unregister.
hadi-march/ui#registerPages.signature: const registerPages: (list: MaybeFn<readonly PageEntry[] | null | undefined>) => (() => void)
hadi-march/ui#registerPages.tr: Sayfaları ({ id, title, href, group, keywords, icon }) aranabilir yapar. `list` bir erişimci olabilir. Kaydı kaldıran işlevi döndürür.

hadi-march/ui#registerThemes.name: registerThemes
hadi-march/ui#registerThemes.doc: Offer extra themes: `registerThemes([{ id: "hadi-marka", name: "HADİ", href: "themes/hadi-marka.css" }])` (CSS made with themeCss()).
hadi-march/ui#registerThemes.tr: Ek temalar sunar: `registerThemes([{ id: "hadiMarka", name: "HADİ", href: "/themes/hadi-marka.css" }])` (CSS themeCss() ile üretilir).

hadi-march/ui#removeAt.name: removeAt
hadi-march/ui#removeAt.signature: function removeAt(root: unknown, p: JsonPath): unknown

hadi-march/ui#renameAt.name: renameAt
hadi-march/ui#renameAt.doc: Rename an object key in place (the order of the keys is kept).
hadi-march/ui#renameAt.signature: function renameAt(root: unknown, p: JsonPath, to: string): unknown
hadi-march/ui#renameAt.tr: Bir nesne anahtarını yerinde yeniden adlandırır (anahtar sırası korunur).

hadi-march/ui#renderFields.name: renderFields
hadi-march/ui#renderFields.doc: Render the active schema fields (`names` or all), honouring `when`, `hidden` and layout.
hadi-march/ui#renderFields.signature: function renderFields<V>(form: FormController<V>, names?: readonly FieldName<V>[] | null, layout?: FieldsLayout): Element
hadi-march/ui#renderFields.tr: Etkin şema alanlarını (`names` ya da tümü) çizer; `when`, `hidden` ve yerleşime uyar.

hadi-march/ui#renderItem.name: renderItem
hadi-march/ui#renderItem.doc: Draw one menu entry: a separator (Divider) or a ListRow (a router link with `href`, a button otherwise). ContextMenu reuses it.
hadi-march/ui#renderItem.signature: function renderItem(it: MenuItem, args: unknown[], close: (refocus: boolean) => void): unknown
hadi-march/ui#renderItem.tr: Tek bir menü girdisini çizer: ayraç, action() düğmesi, yönlendirici bağlantısı ya da düz düğme. ContextMenu da kullanır.

hadi-march/ui#ResizeHandle.name: ResizeHandle
hadi-march/ui#ResizeHandle.doc: `<ResizeHandle value={() => $w} set={(w) => $w = w} min={160} max={480} reset={() => $w = 240} label="Sidebar width" />`

props.name: value
props.doc: The current size: a number (a live JSX value) or an accessor. With `set` the handle is a full separator.

props.name: edge
props.doc: Edge or corner of the parent (default "end"). start / top grow the thing toward the start (`invert`).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name (default "Resize").

props.name: line
props.doc: The line: "hover" (default: on hover, focus and drag), "always", or "none".

props.name: grip
props.doc: A visible grip in the middle: true (a short bar), or your own node.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme colour of the active line (default: the accent).

props.name: disabled
props.doc: No pointer, no focus.

props.name: onStep
props.type: ((dx: number, dy: number, e: KeyboardEvent) => void) | undefined
props.doc: Without `value` + `set`: arrow keys call this with a step in px along x (RTL mirrored) and y; Shift = 4 steps.

props.name: ref
props.doc: Called with the element.

props.name: scale
props.doc: Size units per pointer pixel (default 1); a percent split passes `() => 100 / container width`.

props.name: set
props.doc: Apply a size, already clamped to min / max; `done` is true when a gesture ends (save it then).

props.name: step
props.doc: Keyboard step (default 16); Shift and Page keys move `bigStep` (default 4 × step).

props.name: axis
props.doc: "inline" (default): the handle moves left / right and grows toward the inline end; "block": up / down.

props.name: invert
props.doc: The thing grows toward the inline start / block start (a panel on the end edge).

props.name: reset
props.doc: Enter and double click (default: none).

hadi-march/ui#ResizeHandle.tr: resize-handle davranışının hazır öğesi: kenarda ya da köşede tek görünümlü tutamaç; `value` + `set` ile tam ayırıcı (sürükleme, ok tuşları, ARIA), onlarsız yalın tutamaç. `<ResizeHandle value={() => $w} set={(w) => $w = w} />`.

hadi-march/ui#resolveColor.name: resolveColor
hadi-march/ui#resolveColor.doc: A theme token ("brand-orange", "cat-3", "primary") → the color it has under `el` (a CSS color passes through).
hadi-march/ui#resolveColor.signature: function resolveColor(token: string, el?: Element | null): string
hadi-march/ui#resolveColor.tr: Bir tema belirteci ("brand-orange", "cat-3", "primary") → `el` altında sahip olduğu renk (CSS rengi aynen geçer).

hadi-march/ui#resolvedTheme.name: resolvedTheme
hadi-march/ui#resolvedTheme.doc: Effective theme after resolving "system" with prefers-color-scheme (not reactive to OS changes).
hadi-march/ui#resolvedTheme.tr: "system" değerinin prefers-color-scheme ile çözülmesinden sonraki geçerli tema (işletim sistemi değişikliklerine tepki vermez).

hadi-march/ui#resolveFeatures.name: resolveFeatures
hadi-march/ui#resolveFeatures.doc: The features a prop stands for, over `def` (a config merges by name, a list replaces, a function maps).
hadi-march/ui#resolveFeatures.signature: function resolveFeatures(def: FeaturesProp | undefined, own: FeaturesProp | undefined): LayoutFeature[]
hadi-march/ui#resolveFeatures.tr: Bir `features` değerinin karşılığı olan özellikler: yapılandırma ada göre birleşir, liste yerine geçer, işlev eşler.

hadi-march/ui#rgbToHsv.name: rgbToHsv
hadi-march/ui#rgbToHsv.doc: RGB(A) to HSV(A); `hue` keeps the previous hue for greys (no hue of their own).
hadi-march/ui#rgbToHsv.signature: function rgbToHsv(__0: Rgba, hue: number = 0): Hsva
hadi-march/ui#rgbToHsv.tr: RGB(A) → HSV(A); `hue`, griler için önceki tonu korur (kendi tonları yoktur).

hadi-march/ui#RichTextEditor.name: RichTextEditor
hadi-march/ui#RichTextEditor.doc: Rich text editor: `<RichTextEditor bind:value={$markdown} mentions={team} />`. The value is Markdown.

props.name: toolbar
props.doc: Toolbar items (default DEFAULT_TOOLS); false hides the toolbar (shortcuts still work).

props.name: mentions
props.type: readonly Mention[] | ((query: string) => readonly Mention[] | Promise<readonly Mention[]>) | undefined
props.doc: People for

props.name: emoji
props.doc: :emoji suggestions (default true; a list replaces the built-in set).

props.name: shortcuts
props.doc: Markdown shortcuts while typing (default true).

props.name: history
props.doc: Undo history to record into (default: the editor's own; pass undoStack() to share the app's).

props.name: rows
props.doc: Minimum height of the writing area in lines (default 6).

props.name: counter
props.doc: Word / character counter under the text (default true).

props.name: api
props.doc: Receives the editor API once mounted.

props.name: hint
props.doc: The "Type @ to mention, : for emoji" hint under the text (default true; `counter={false}` removes the whole foot).

props.name: toolIcons
props.doc: Own icon (any node or text) for a toolbar button: `{ bold: "B", link: <Icon of={chain} /> }`.

props.name: labels
props.type: { editor?: string; toolbar?: string; tools?: Partial<Record<Exclude<ToolName, "|">, string>>; link?: string; linkAddress?: string; linkHelp?: string; apply?: string; removeLink?: string; suggestions?: string; noMatches?: string; keepTyping?: string; hint?: string; count?: (words: number, characters: number) => string; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts; defaults are the translated ones. `tools` names the toolbar buttons, `count` writes the counter.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#RichTextEditor.tr: Zengin metin düzenleyicisi: `<RichTextEditor bind:value={$markdown} mentions={team} />`. Değer Markdown'dır.

hadi-march/ui#routeFocusFeature.name: routeFocusFeature
hadi-march/ui#routeFocusFeature.doc: After a route change: focus moves to the page (main) and the new title is read out; nothing moves on first load.
hadi-march/ui#routeFocusFeature.tr: Layout özelliği: sayfa değişince odağı yeni sayfanın başlığına taşır ve ekran okuyucuya duyurur.

hadi-march/ui#RowTools.name: RowTools
hadi-march/ui#RowTools.doc: `<RowTools index={i} count={() => list().length} onUp={…} onDown={…} onRemove={…} />`, `<RowTools actions={["remove"]} onRemove={…} />`

props.name: actions
props.doc: Which tools, in this order (default: up, down, remove).

props.name: onAction
props.doc: One handler for every tool (called besides onUp / onDown / onRemove).

props.name: index
props.doc: Position of the row: "up" is off on the first row.

props.name: count
props.doc: Rows in the list: "down" is off on the last row.

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Switch all tools off, or some: `{ remove: () => list().length <= 1 }`.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Own names (default "Move up", "Move down", "Remove", group "Row tools"; translated).

props.name: icons
props.doc: Own icons: an icon, text, a node or `() => node` each (a node is copied for every row).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme colour token of the icons.

props.name: danger
props.doc: The remove tool in the danger colour.

hadi-march/ui#RowTools.tr: Düzenlenebilir listede satır araçları (yukarı, aşağı, sil); uçlarda kapanır: `<RowTools index={i} count={n} onUp={…} onDown={…} onRemove={…} />`

hadi-march/ui#sample.name: sample
hadi-march/ui#sample.doc: Every target's values at `t`: { logo: { x: 12, rotate: 30 }, … }.
hadi-march/ui#sample.signature: function sample(model: TimelineModel, t: number): Record<string, Partial<Record<TimelineProp, number>>>
hadi-march/ui#sample.tr: `t` anında her hedefin değerleri: { logo: { x: 12, rotate: 30 }, … }.

hadi-march/ui#sampleTrack.name: sampleTrack
hadi-march/ui#sampleTrack.doc: The value of a track at `t` ms.
hadi-march/ui#sampleTrack.signature: function sampleTrack(track: TimelineTrack, t: number): number

hadi-march/ui#schemaAt.name: schemaAt
hadi-march/ui#schemaAt.doc: The schema that applies at `p` (for hints and enum pickers).
hadi-march/ui#schemaAt.signature: function schemaAt(schema: JsonSchema | undefined, p: JsonPath): JsonSchema | undefined
hadi-march/ui#schemaAt.tr: `p` konumunda geçerli olan şema (ipuçları ve enum seçicileri için).

hadi-march/ui#score.name: score
hadi-march/ui#score.doc: Score `query` against an item's title (and keywords, weighted lower). 0 = no match; higher is better. Every query word must match somewhere. Exact prefixes beat word starts, beat substrings, beat typo matches.
hadi-march/ui#score.signature: function score(query: string, title: string, keywords: Keywords = ""): number
hadi-march/ui#score.tr: `query` değerini öğenin başlığına (daha az ağırlıkla anahtar sözcüklerine) göre puanlar: 0 eşleşme yok, yüksek daha iyi; önek > sözcük başı > alt dize > yazım hatası.
